title: Unit Event — Rekindle the Flame — Episode4 That Fire

meta.Event Outline: Having surpassed RAD WEEKEND, Vivid BAD SQUAD's next goal is to stand on top of the world. As each member strives to better themselves, something seems to be eating at Akito...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That event was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I also really enjoyed it since we hadn't performed in front of an audience in so long.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Exactly!
What if we started working more events into our practice schedule?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I get why you're excited...
But have you done your English homework due tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh?! No, I forgot...!
I need to do it when I get home...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We don't have practice today, so please make sure that you do.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, let's call it a day here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: By the way, I already finished my homework...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I made sure to get an early start on them since I knew we'd be performing in an event today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Your foresight is admirable.
I couldn't be prouder as your partner.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Do you think you'll be back on your feet soon...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
It's subtle, but it's affecting your singing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ever since RAD BLAST, I've been having trouble singing with the same power.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm missing that something I had a hold of that time...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If it's showing in my singing, then that means the other two must also know.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I suspect that's the case.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But the fact that they haven't said anything about it means...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I need to get back in the saddle as fast as I can.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Don't look so concerned.
I'm not gonna go off and do anything crazy.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, in the meantime, we'll be waiting.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's subtle, but it's affecting your singing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I still want to stand on top of the world with them, and I'm doing everything I can to make that happen.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(There's something missing.
I don't feel as driven as I did that time...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(I have to do something.
Because if I don't, I'll be holding them back.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But what am I supposed to do...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(How do I get the drive I felt back then...?
That fire...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Brooding in my room isn't gonna solve anything.
